items.title: Prognostic value of measuring leukemia stem cell frequency in AML: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: Systematic review and reconstructed individual-patient-data meta-analysis evaluating leukemia stem cell (LSC) frequency as a prognostic marker in acute myeloid leukemia, quantifying its association with overall and event-free survival when measured at diagnosis and in remission to refine risk stratification and residual-disease monitoring.

items.title: Boosting anti-leukemia cytotoxicity of CD4 and CD8 T cells through combined inhibition of MEK and HDAC
items.abstract: Drug-repurposing screen identifying that combined MEK and HDAC inhibition (trametinib plus quisinostat) potently boosts CD4/CD8 T-cell cytotoxicity against AML in mouse and human models, offering a strategy to make T-cell immunotherapies effective in a disease where they have historically underperformed.

items.title: The FOLR2-IRF2BP2 axis mediates erythropoiesis impairment by excess folic acid in myelodysplastic neoplasms
items.abstract: Metabolomic and functional study showing excess folic acid, acting through a FOLR2-IRF2BP2 axis, impairs erythropoiesis and exacerbates anemia in myelodysplastic neoplasms, with folic-acid restriction alleviating anemia in MDS mouse models.

items.title: Non-invasive multiparametric characterization of essential thrombocythemia, prefibrotic and overt myelofibrosis
items.abstract: Prospective study of 128 patients (44 ET, 53 prefibrotic MF, 21 overt MF) evaluating non-invasive parameters to distinguish these MPN subtypes, showing the mutational landscape grows increasingly complex from ET to prefibrotic to overt myelofibrosis and identifying differentially expressed markers that could reduce reliance on marrow biopsy.

items.title: SLF2 and SMC5 dysfunction drives HSC aging and predisposes to MDS, defining a new inherited bone marrow failure syndrome
items.abstract: Mechanistic study of Atelis Syndrome (pathogenic SLF2/SMC5 variants) showing the resulting hematopoietic progenitor defects drive stem-cell aging and early-onset MDS, establishing SLF2/SMC5 dysfunction as a new inherited bone marrow failure syndrome with leukemia predisposition.

items.title: Glofitamab plus gemcitabine and oxaliplatin for relapsed/refractory DLBCL: 3-year follow-up of STARGLO
items.abstract: Three-year follow-up of the phase 3 STARGLO trial in transplant-ineligible relapsed/refractory DLBCL, where glofitamab plus GemOx maintained superior overall survival versus rituximab-GemOx (median OS 25.5 vs 12.5 months; HR 0.60) with durable responses across clinically relevant subgroups.

items.title: Atezolizumab for relapsed/refractory extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma: phase 2 of the NCCH1903/ATTACK trial
items.abstract: Multicenter single-arm phase 2 NCCH1903/ATTACK trial of atezolizumab monotherapy in relapsed/refractory extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, reporting objective response rate assessed by independent review in a rare, aggressive disease with limited salvage options.

items.title: Real-world treatment patterns of patients with large B-cell lymphoma over time and into a post-CAR T approval era
items.abstract: Retrospective Flatiron Health database study of large B-cell lymphoma treatment patterns and survival into the post-CAR T approval era, quantifying real-world CAR-T uptake and identifying predictors of early mortality before patients reach second-line therapy.

items.title: Large B-cell lymphoma after CD19 CAR-T failure: updated real-world outcomes, prognostic factors, and prediction models
items.abstract: Single-center retrospective cohort of large B-cell lymphoma patients who relapsed or progressed after CD19 CAR-T, developing clinical prediction models for survival after subsequent therapy in a setting where outcomes remain poor and prognostic tools are lacking.

items.title: Talquetamab in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma: 3-year follow-up of the phase 1/2 MonumenTAL-1 study
items.abstract: Three-year follow-up of MonumenTAL-1 for the GPRC5D-directed bispecific talquetamab in relapsed/refractory myeloma, reporting overall response rates of 67-74% in T-cell-redirection-naive cohorts with durable responses and characterizing the distinctive skin, nail and oral GPRC5D-related toxicities over long-term dosing.

items.title: Association between diabetic control and progression of monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance to multiple myeloma
items.abstract: Retrospective cohort of US Veterans with MGUS and pre-existing diabetes showing that time-varying poor glycemic control (HbA1c >7%) is associated with a higher risk of progression from MGUS to multiple myeloma, suggesting a potentially modifiable progression risk factor.

items.title: Measurable residual disease-dependent unfavorable outcomes in pediatric PAX5-rearranged B-acute lymphoblastic leukemia
items.abstract: Analysis of 159 pediatric PAX5-rearranged B-ALL cases treated within AIEOP-BFM ALL studies across Italy, Germany and Austria, revealing high-risk clinical features and higher relapse rates versus non-PAX5-r ALL, with MRD identifying the patients at greatest risk of unfavorable outcome.

items.title: Contemporary management of relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia
items.abstract: Review of relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL management in the targeted-agent era, framing sequencing decisions after covalent BTK inhibitors and venetoclax-based fixed-duration or MRD-guided frontline regimens, integrating progression kinetics, assessment for Richter transformation, and genomic re-evaluation.

items.title: ELTS score and early 'warning' define a two-stage risk framework for failure-free survival in chronic-phase CML
items.abstract: Pooled analysis of 710 newly diagnosed chronic-phase CML patients from the prospective JALSG CML212 and New TARGET studies, proposing a two-stage risk framework that combines the ELTS score with an early ELN-2025 'warning' state to predict failure-free survival in the tyrosine kinase inhibitor era.

items.title: ZMYM3 mutations modulate histone acetylation and cooperate with NOTCH1 mutations in chronic lymphocytic leukemia
items.abstract: Next-generation sequencing of 487 CLL patients characterizing recurrent loss-of-function ZMYM3 mutations, which are strongly enriched for co-occurring NOTCH1 pathway alterations and modulate histone acetylation, defining their clinical and functional impact in CLL.

items.title: Early neurologic response predicts outcomes after anakinra for immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome
items.abstract: Analysis of 101 patients treated with the IL-1 receptor antagonist anakinra for ICANS (90 corticosteroid-refractory) after CAR T-cell therapy, showing median time to ICANS resolution of 8 days and that early neurologic response predicts recovery, helping guide use of anakinra in severe neurotoxicity.

items.title: CAR-FIT: a CAR-T fitness index integrating comorbidity and geriatric assessment to guide safe, equitable delivery of CAR-T
items.abstract: Retrospective single-center study of 80 relapsed DLBCL patients proposing CAR-FIT, a fitness index integrating frailty and comorbidity scores that stratified 1-year overall and progression-free survival across fit, borderline and unfit groups to guide safer, more equitable CAR-T selection in patients with borderline physiological reserve.

items.title: Impact of prior bendamustine exposure on CAR T-cell therapy outcomes in follicular lymphoma
items.abstract: Retrospective TriNetX cohort of relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma showing prior bendamustine exposure is associated with inferior CD19-directed CAR T-cell outcomes, extending to follicular lymphoma a T-cell-fitness concern previously described in large B-cell lymphoma.

items.title: PTCy-based allo-BMT as a curative, accessible alternative for pediatric and young-adult severe aplastic anemia
items.abstract: Study of a posttransplant-cyclophosphamide (PTCy) haploidentical allogeneic bone marrow transplant platform as a curative, donor-accessible option for pediatric and young-adult severe aplastic anemia, evaluating graft failure, GVHD and survival where matched sibling donors are unavailable.

items.title: Haploidentical transplant, gene therapy, and standard care in sickle cell disease: a cost-effectiveness analysis
items.abstract: Cost-effectiveness analysis comparing nonmyeloablative haploidentical allogeneic transplant, gene therapy and standard care for sickle cell disease, weighing durable-remission benefits against the very high upfront cost of gene therapy and the decades of life expectancy lost under standard care.

items.title: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibition exacerbates anemia in sickle cell disease
items.abstract: Multicenter analysis combining a 658-patient Walk-PHaSST cross-sectional cohort, two longitudinal cohorts and a mouse model showing that renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitors - often used for albuminuria in sickle cell disease - independently lower hemoglobin and reduce erythroid colony formation, warranting close hemoglobin monitoring.

items.title: How I treat bleeding in women and girls with hemophilia and hemophilia carriers
items.abstract: How I Treat review on recognizing and managing bleeding in women and girls with hemophilia and hemophilia carriers, reflecting the 2021 ISTH reclassification and a shift away from viewing carriers as unaffected by reduced factor VIII/IX levels.

items.title: Platelet-activating anti-platelet factor 4 disorders
items.abstract: Review of the platelet-activating anti-PF4 disorders spectrum, spanning classic heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, autoimmune and spontaneous HIT variants, and vaccine-induced immune thrombotic thrombocytopenia (VITT), detailing their distinct antibody behaviors and highly prothrombotic clinical features.

items.title: First-line PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab plus chemotherapy in triple-negative breast cancer: a phase 2 trial
items.abstract: Open-label multicenter single-arm phase 2 trial of the PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for locally advanced unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, reporting safety and antitumor activity for pairing checkpoint blockade with VEGF inhibition.

items.title: SKYSCRAPER-03: phase 3 tiragolumab plus atezolizumab versus durvalumab in unresectable stage III NSCLC after chemoradiation
items.abstract: Phase 3 open-label randomized SKYSCRAPER-03 trial comparing consolidation with the anti-TIGIT antibody tiragolumab plus atezolizumab versus durvalumab in locally advanced, unresectable stage III NSCLC after platinum-based concurrent chemoradiation, testing dual TIGIT/PD-L1 blockade against standard immunotherapy consolidation.

items.title: AI-based augmentation of oncology clinical trials
items.abstract: Review of artificial-intelligence applications across the oncology clinical-trial lifecycle, arguing the most immediate evidence-supported role is augmenting operational workflows under human oversight - patient identification, eligibility assessment, data extraction and monitoring - while synthetic control arms and digital twins remain early and unvalidated.

items.title: Talquetamab-daratumumab in relapsed or refractory myeloma (MonumenTAL-3)
items.abstract: Phase 3 trial randomizing relapsed/refractory myeloma patients with at least one prior line to the GPRC5D bispecific talquetamab plus daratumumab and pomalidomide (Tal-DP), talquetamab plus daratumumab (Tal-D), or daratumumab-pomalidomide-dexamethasone; the talquetamab combinations improved progression-free survival, supporting a move of GPRC5D-directed therapy into earlier lines - coinciding with the FDA accelerated approval of talquetamab.

items.title: Intracranial delivery of B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells for recurrent glioblastoma: a phase 1 trial
items.abstract: Complete results of an open-label phase 1 dose-escalation trial of autologous B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells (TX103) delivered by intracranial infusion for B7-H3-positive recurrent glioblastoma, reporting safety and early efficacy for locoregional CAR-T delivery in a brain tumor with few options.

items.title: Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells in B cell lymphomas
items.abstract: Study characterizing the extent and biology of long-term persistence of 4-1BB-costimulated anti-CD19 CAR T cells (CART19) in B-cell lymphoma patients, documenting detectable CAR T cells up to a decade after infusion and profiling the phenotype of these ultra-long-lived cells.

items.title: Latent effector T cells mediate immunotherapy responses in the bone marrow microenvironment
items.abstract: Integrating TCR profiling, HLA immunopeptidomics and functional screening in multiple myeloma and AML, this study defines a latent but activatable tumor-reactive T-cell program in bone marrow distinct from solid-tumor exhaustion, and builds a transcriptional classifier (TFiT) that stratifies immunotherapy - but not chemotherapy - response.

items.title: Beyond BCL-2: what drives venetoclax resistance in acute myeloid leukemia?
items.abstract: Review mapping the increasingly defined mechanisms of venetoclax resistance in AML - compensatory or lineage-associated switches toward MCL-1 or BCL-xL dependence, oncogenic signaling, differentiation state, emerging BAX mutations and metabolic adaptations sustaining oxidative phosphorylation - and their implications for combination strategies.
